headline: France's VusionGroup Offers 30% Premium to Acquire Sweden's Pricer
summary: Paris-listed smart label provider VusionGroup launched a takeover bid for Swedish electronic shelf-label maker Pricer with a premium of nearly 30%. Pricer's board of directors unanimously recommended that shareholders accept the offer.
why: VusionGroup and Pricer are global suppliers of electronic shelf labels and digital retail infrastructure for physical supermarket and store automation.

impacts.name: Pricer
impacts.why: The cash offer from VusionGroup carries an approximate 30% premium over prevailing market prices.
